messages:
Anika (CS): Quick sync — Valora Labs put their production cutover on hold because the DPA asks us to confirm key provenance and whether hosted embeddings can use customer-managed keys. They're calling it a blocker.

Jared (SEng): Which deployment mode? Hosted vs Dedicated behaves differently for BYOK.

Anika (CS): Hosted API. They want key isolation for embeddings and asked if we can do HSM-backed wrapping or if they need to pre-wrap blobs.

Rajat (Security): Short answer: hosted supports customer-managed keys via cloud KMS integrations (AWS/GCP/Azure) with envelope encryption; for enterprise accounts we can enable EKM/HSM-backed flows. We do not accept raw private keys.

Priya (PM): Customer wants a DPA addendum that says "keys remain customer-owned and are never exported by Redwood." Can we commit?

Rajat (Security): We can commit to ownership and non-export of unwrapped keys. Implementation note: if customer asks Redwood to perform migration/restore using wrapped blobs, support might need to operate on those blobs under documented change-control. Suggested contractual language: "Customer retains ownership of their KMS keys. Redwood will not store or export unwrapped customer keys. Any operational use of wrapped key material is subject to documented change-control and customer authorization."

Jared (SEng): For onboarding we need a checklist: KMS ARN, cross-account IAM role, test encrypt/decrypt, and a perf note — EKM calls can add latency to embeddings ops (estimate 5–50ms depending on region and provider). I'll add an ENG ticket.

Anika (CS): Draft reply to Valora: "We support customer-managed keys via cloud KMS with envelope encryption. Redwood does not export unwrapped keys. We'll provide a DPA addendum and an onboarding checklist. Please confirm your KMS provider and whether HSM attestation is required." Thoughts?

Priya (PM): LGTM. Add: legal+security sign-off target = 3 business days if no unusual asks.

Rajat (Security): I'll post a short security blurb and map to SOC2 controls (key management/crypto ops) here by EOD, then loop Legal.

sec-bot: New internal doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/dpa/byok-hosted-embeddings — review when available. Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 72h.

Anika (CS): Thanks. Marking this as onboarding-blocking in the CRM and pinging Valora now. Will update when legal confirms.

Jared (SEng): ENG ticket ENG-7834 created for BYOK onboarding template and perf checklist.

Anika (CS): Closing loop in this thread after legal signs the addendum.
notes: Thread about hosted DPA question, BYOK for embeddings, contractual wording, SOC2 mapping, onboarding checklist, and engineering perf note
